details: meridian-auth before 1.0.1 only checks a session token's HMAC signature when the token carries one. A token with an empty signature is accepted unverified, so an attacker can mint a session with any claims -- including role=admin -- without knowing the service secret. Services that read the role from the session, such as the Meridian customer portal, grant the admin console to a forged session. Fixed in 1.0.1, which rejects any token without a valid signature.
